column2: Retain Alexander/Philip, Macedonian identity, Kittim, Darius over Persians/Medes, succession and prior Greek rule. The English consolidates the repeated striking into the named defeat rather than inventing an object for the opening infinitive.
column3: The opening construction and placement of formerly over Greece remain provisional; historical reconstruction is not substituted for the selected sequence.

column2: Retain many wars, possession of strongholds and slaughter of kings. Slaughter is not softened into merely defeating rulers.
Retain earth's ends, a multitude of nations' spoils, the earth quiet before him, exaltation and lifted heart. The unnamed exalted subject is contextually Alexander.
column3: The subject shift after earth became quiet remains an inference; the bodily pride image is preserved.

column2: Retain a very strong army, countries/nations/rulers and tribute to him. Rulers is a provisional broad rendering of the political title, not a claim that all were modern tyrants.
Retain falling onto the bed and knowledge of approaching death. No specific illness or manner of death is supplied.

Retain distinguished officers raised with him from youth, division of his kingdom and his still being alive. Officers is a contextual court/military rendering of servants; no independent historical correction is imposed.
Retain twelve years and Alexander's death. The narrative's regnal figure is not recalculated into an external chronology.
Retain his officers taking power, each in his place. This does not erase the preceding division while Alexander lived.

Retain all wearing diadems after his death, their sons after them, many years and multiplied evils. The second group's implied wearing/reigning remains elliptical rather than separately reconstructed.
Retain the sinful-root image, Antiochus Epiphanes son of Antiochus, Roman hostage status and Greek-kingdom year 137. No modern calendar equivalent is inserted.

Retain lawless sons arising from Israel, persuasion and their argument for a covenant with surrounding nations because separation brought evils. The causal claim belongs to the speakers, not the narrator.
Retain the proposal as good in their eyes. The eyes idiom records perceived approval rather than narrator endorsement.
Retain willing/eager representatives, approach to the king and authority for national ordinances. Do not identify the king anew beyond the narrative context.
Retain the Jerusalem gymnasium and national customs. The sentence continues into the anatomical and covenant actions in verse 15.

Propose were yoked and were sold for the two selected passive verbs, preserving the explicit self-reference in made foreskins for themselves and the active abandonment of the covenant. The close draft keeps the inherited reflexive renderings.
column3: The passives may carry voluntary/reflexive force in context; the closer passive wording does not establish external coercion. The foreskin expression needs specialist explanation without an invented procedure in the reading.

column2: Retain the kingdom established before Antiochus, his intention regarding Egypt and rule over two kingdoms. Do not replace the aspiration with an already completed conquest.
Retain heavy force, chariots, elephants, cavalry and great fleet. The listed types are distinct and no troop counts are invented.
Retain war with Ptolemy, his reversal and flight, and many falling wounded. Wounded is not changed to slain; the reversal verb is read from its military context.
Retain plural capture of Egyptian strongholds and singular taking of Egyptian spoils. The number shift is not regularized to a single uniform agent.
Retain year 143, return after striking Egypt, ascent against Israel and ascent to Jerusalem with heavy force. The repeated ascent is not collapsed into a single unqualified journey.
Retain arrogant sanctuary entry, golden altar, lampstand for light and all its articles. The inventory continues into verse 22.

Retain presentation table, libation vessels, bowls, gold censers, curtain, crowns and front-of-temple gold ornament, then stripping everything. Do not replace crowns with a specific unexpressed architectural ornament.
column3: The exact ritual vessel identifications and stripping verb remain provisional lexical choices.

column2: Retain silver, gold, desirable vessels and hidden treasures found, with repeated taking represented in the coordinated English. No amount is supplied.
Retain taking everything, return to his land, bloodshed and great arrogant speech in the selected order. Do not move the violence earlier to repair perceived chronology.
Retain great mourning throughout Israel's dwelling places as the introduction to the following lament. No poetic words are added to heighten the grief.
Retain rulers/elders groaning, young women/men weakening and women's altered beauty. Three proposed display lines separate the three lament clauses without changing wording.
column3: Young women is broader than the lexical virgin designation; the age/marital-status balance remains provisional.

column2: Retain every bridegroom's lament and the woman sitting in the bridal chamber mourning. Bride is supplied from the bridal context and feminine participle, not an expressed bride noun. Two display lines preserve the parallel.
Retain earth shaking over inhabitants and Jacob's whole house clothing itself in shame. Two proposed display lines distinguish the personified earth and collective-house images.
Retain two full years, the chief tribute collector, Judah's cities and heavy force arriving at Jerusalem. Do not supply Apollonius as an unexpressed name.
column3: The collector's exact administrative title and the interval's historical reckoning remain open.

column2: Retain deceitful peaceful words, trust, sudden assault, great blow and many Israelites destroyed. The peace language is explicitly deceptive within the narrative.
Retain spoils, burning, demolished houses and surrounding walls. The city remains the same object throughout rather than a new unnamed settlement.
Retain plural captors, women/children captive and livestock acquired. The plural agent is contextually the invading force.
Retain David's city fortified with a great strong wall and strong towers, becoming their citadel. Citadel renders the common noun without asserting an archaeological identification.
Retain sinful nation/lawless men stationed and strengthening in it. The moral labels belong to the narrative and are not replaced with a guessed ethnicity.
Retain weapons and food, Jerusalem spoils stored there and the plural becoming a great trap. Do not silently make the final plural subject an assured singular fortress.
column3: The trap's plural antecedent may be people or the accumulated provisions/spoil; it remains unresolved.

column2: Retain singular ambush for the sanctuary and continuing evil adversary for Israel. Adversary is not a proper name Devil or an asserted supernatural identity.
Retain innocent blood around the sanctuary and defilement of that same sanctuary. The repeated sacred-location noun is preserved.
Retain flight because of them, Jerusalem as foreign dwelling, estrangement from those born in her and children's abandonment. Four proposed clause lines preserve the feminine city personification.
Retain sanctuary as wilderness, festivals to mourning, Sabbaths to reproach and honor to contempt. Four proposed display lines keep each corresponding loss distinct.
Retain dishonor proportionate to glory and height turned into mourning. Two proposed display lines preserve the paired reversal without intensifying it beyond the selected text.
Retain the king's kingdom-wide writing and all becoming one people. The abandonment requirement continues in verse 42.
Retain each abandoning personal customs and all nations receiving the royal word. Do not omit each or replace the reported totality with a historical qualification.
Retain many Israelites accepting his worship, sacrificing to idols and profaning Sabbath. His may refer to the king's prescribed worship rather than personal worship of the king.
column3: The worship possessive remains open and should not be treated as proof of ruler divinization.

column2: Retain letters through messengers to Jerusalem/Judah cities and customs foreign to the land. Ordering supplies the function of the following infinitival decree without inventing a separate verbatim command.
Retain suppression of burnt offerings, sacrifice and libation from the sanctuary and profanation of Sabbaths/festivals. The three offerings and two calendar categories remain distinct.
Retain defilement of sanctuary and holy people. The masculine plural supports people rather than an unexplained second sanctuary noun.

Retain pagan altars, precincts and idol shrines, pigs and unclean livestock. Pagan distinguishes this altar term in context from the temple altar; it is not a blanket lexical replacement outside this passage.
column3: The three cult structures and common/unclean food terminology remain provisional specialist choices.

column2: Retain uncircumcised sons and self-defilement through every uncleanness/profanation. The English reflexive selves represents souls in this construction without making a separate body/soul doctrine claim.
Retain the intended forgetting of law and alteration of all ordinances. This purpose follows the preceding decree rather than a new accomplished event.
Retain death for whoever fails to act according to the king's word. Was to die backshifts the decree's future within indirect narration; no execution method is supplied.
Retain kingdom-wide writing according to all these words, overseers for all people and sacrifice city by city. The distributive repetition is preserved.
Retain many gathering to them, every law-abandoner and evils in the land. Them is contextually the appointed authorities without an inserted proper name.
Retain Israel driven into concealment in all places of refuge. The causative drove interprets their putting Israel into hidden places without creating an additional exile.
column3: The possessive of the refuges remains contextually associated with collective Israel.

column2: Retain Chislev fifteen in year 145, singular builder of the desolating abomination on the altar and plural builders of other altars around Judah. Do not substitute a named deity or erase the number shift.
Retain incense at house doors and in squares. No particular officiant or offering object is supplied.
Retain discovery of law books, tearing apart before burning and explicit fire. The participle's prior preparation is made readable in English sequence.

Retain recurring discovery of a covenant book with someone, approval of the law and the royal decree executing him. Or is an English coordination of the two triggering conditions rather than a claim that only simultaneous possession and assent were punishable.
column3: The coordination of the two conditions and the decree's collective judicial sense remain provisional.

column2: Retain action by their power against Israelites found in cities month after month. In this way supplies the connection to the preceding punishments, not an extra method.
Retain sacrifice on day twenty-five and the pagan altar upon the temple altar. The two altar terms and their vertical relation remain distinct.
Retain women who circumcised their children put to death under the decree. Their agency in arranging or performing circumcision is not more narrowly specified.
Retain infants hung from their necks and the households/circumcisers as additional victims. Also killed supplies the governing action from verse 60 for the final objects.
column3: Whose necks, the attachment of the household objects and the implicit killing versus hanging remain unresolved; no unexpressed execution detail is asserted as certain.

column2: Retain many standing firm and strengthening themselves against eating unclean things. The paired resolve is not reduced to mere preference.
Retain chosen acceptance of death, both nondefilement and covenant nonprofanation purposes, and actual deaths. The final death statement is not removed as redundant.
Retain extremely great wrath upon Israel. Its agent is not expressly named and no divine possessive is added.
